pairwise_identification: Require a complete 2x2 matched subset family or equivalent intervention set that eliminates both single-coordinate reconstructions under fixed G,E.
three_way_identification: Require all single knockouts and enough pairwise cells to reject every pairwise reconstruction under fixed G,E.
four_way_identification: Require enough cells to reject all lower-order models; incomplete support is HOLD/UNDERIDENTIFIED, never zero.
context_geometry_rule: Any claimed XxG or XxE term requires an orthogonal same-X control with G or E varied alone.
cross_domain_rule: A reproducible interaction law requires at least two mechanistically distinct software domains supporting the same edge or hyperedge semantics.
sparsity_rule: Do not infer sparsity from absent evidence. Sparsity authority requires identified zero lower-order terms inside a supported family.
harvest_rule: Harvest is non-sovereign and parallel. Literature or cross-lab fragments may kill novelty, seed tests, or survive a P17 rejection, but may not rescue a failed scientific interaction claim.
paper_rule: Maintain paper-candidate hypotheses in Harvest only; scientific thresholds remain fixed.
anti_rationalization: No new primitive, interaction subset, matched-family tolerance, or action class after fresh outcomes.
law_r2_gate: Only same-(X,G,E) conflicting action surviving complete interaction reconstruction may reopen LAW-R2.
